alex: heads-up — customer hit crash when hosted fell back to private. runtime errored: "unknown field: enriched_payload"

priya: ah, new envelope region `enriched_payload`. older adapters only validate `core` + `assets`.

sam: is this the case where hosted sent `enriched_payload` only when model returned tools+embeds? we toggled it behind a feature flag last week.

jules: three choices: 1) force capability handshake (strict), 2) host-side translate (translate), 3) runtime permissive parse (lenient). each has tradeoffs.

alex: i'm against permissive runtimes — hides contract drift. strict is ideal but breaks air-gapped customers.

priya: proposed hybrid: add capability `envelope_enriched_v1`. Hosting will attempt deterministic translate -> `core` when capability absent, set header `X-Envelope-Translated: 1`, and increment metric `envelope_translated_count`. If translation would need to mutate opaque blobs (signed tokens), abort and return 409 + {code: "upgrade_required"}.

sam: add tenant-level feature-flag so we can disable translation per-tenant. also require translation to run < 5ms P99 or fail to avoid SLO regressions.

jules: +1. translation must copy opaque blobs verbatim. no re-signing. add unit tests in `probe-harness` and perf tests in `probe-profiling`.

priya: ops action: publish tiny `env-normalizer` shim for Dedicated/private customers that normalizes envelopes locally. migration note: recommend enabling shim or upgrading adapter within 60 days.

ops-bot: probe-job 12004 passed on staging at 2026-03-26T12:04:00Z :white_check_mark:

alex: i'll write the small ADR and add rollback runbook if translation causes >20ms added latency at P50. ping eng-arch when RFC ready.
